name: Wildlife Conservation Network Conservation Partners
summary: Long-term partnership offering fiscal sponsorship, flexible funding, fundraising and organisational support to locally led nonprofits working on threatened wildlife species. Organisations that meet the criteria can express interest and then go through a four-step vetting process.
reporting: Partners share financial and programmatic reports with WCN, starting during the onboarding process.
